The weather was sunny that day. The chess corner is one of the best places in the city. Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, a crow sat on the fence, watching us.
Last Tuesday, Tom and David went to the chess corner. Tom is going to travel to Tokyo in April. Life is full of small surprises. The kite rose high above the field.
David is interested in swimming. Tom spent the weekend at the gym. They took many photos at the photo club. What's more, a film poster covers one whole wall.
Tom and David had great fun there. Tom's favorite animal is the cat. It takes twenty minutes to get to the chess corner by bike.
